title: This Jet Ran Out of Fuel at 41,000 Feet
text:
On July 23, 1983, Air Canada Flight 143 left with 22,300 pounds of fuel instead of the 22,300 kilograms it needed, less than half the right load. Captain Bob Pearson, an experienced glider pilot, glided the Boeing 767 for 17 minutes to Gimli, Manitoba. All 69 aboard survived, and the plane flew until 2008.

Follow for true stories that sound made up.

Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gimli_Glider
